summary: Both main translations independently cover all selected Greek clauses without a concrete semantic fidelity defect. They preserve the universal request, negations, resistance condition, difficult empty-jar comparison, speaker changes, and final enslavement; reader-facing servant follows policy. Revision is confined to specific evidential claims in the shared notes that the supplied bounded extracts do not document. The failed no_added_claims checks concern those note claims, not added theology in the translations. The disclosed working restorations should not be replaced merely because alternatives exist. This review evaluates the supplied source and attributed reports, not unseen manuscripts or exhaustive collation; any revised wording requires fresh review.
